title: Arkansas Residential Landlord-Tenant Act of 2007 (Arkansas Code, Title 18, Subtitle 2, Chapter 17)
verified_how: Expanded 'Title 18 Property' then 'Subtitle 2. Real Property' in the official public-access table of contents: 'Chapter 16 Landlord and Tenant' and 'Chapter 17 Arkansas Residential Landlord-Tenant Act of 2007' are both listed live, with 'Chapters 18-26 [Reserved.]' after them.
notes: Chapter 16 retains the older landlord and tenant provisions, including the criminal failure-to-vacate provision Arkansas is known for; Chapter 17 is the modern residential Act. General consumer protection is the Deceptive Trade Practices Act in Title 4, ch. 88, which was not examined. Table-of-contents-level verification only.
